 About The Role
 In this role, you will join a team working with a leading global online automotive marketplace, supporting the development of its core consumer-facing products. You will focus on building and enhancing a high-traffic mobile application used by millions of users, contributing to one of the fastest-growing areas of the client’s business.
You will collaborate closely with UX specialists and engineering colleagues, taking an active part in the full software development lifecycle, from design and architectural discussions through development, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement.
 Responsibilities
Build and enhance differentiated mobile application experiences
Contribute to mobile application architecture and continuously improve the mobile ecosystem
Develop accessible, intuitive, and user-friendly features in close collaboration with the UX team
Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality mobile application functionality
Deliver and release changes regularly to a mobile application used by millions of users
Develop well-structured, scalable, and high-performing mobile solutions
Participate in architectural design discussions and technology selection
Share technical expertise, best practices, and knowledge with engineering colleagues
Integrate and implement third-party solutions within the mobile application
Collaborate closely with cross-functional team members throughout the full development lifecycle
 Requirements
Strong hands-on experience in JavaScript development
Solid proficiency in React Native, TypeScript, and React
Experience with third-party integrations and implementations
Strong ability to develop well-structured and performant mobile applications
Good understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software design patterns
Strong communication and collaboration skills, combined with attention to detail
Experience with AppsFlyer, Iterable, or OneTrust would be an advantage
Willingness to work with BE side - Java
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, international environment
